context_requirements: Cells must be actively replicating DNA for polymerase inhibition to cause replication stress and DNA damage.
Functional DNA damage response signaling (ATM/ATR-CHK1/CHK2-p53) is required for the transcriptional response.
TP53 status modulates the strength of p53-dependent target induction; TP53-mutant lines may show weaker or altered responses.
Rapidly dividing lines with high S-phase fraction are more responsive than slowly dividing lines.
falsifiers: No induction of CDKN1A, GADD45A, or other p53/DNA-damage response genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
No decrease in proliferation-associated genes (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, MCM3, PCNA) at 24 h.
A transcriptional response indistinguishable from vehicle across all lines and time points.
Strong induction of unfolded protein response or heat shock genes without DNA damage response genes.
